question: What size and placement define the central projection on the upper story?
premises: The element is extended on the upper story.
It is identified as the central projection.
Its measure is one fire-part, that is one of three parts.
inference: The central projection on the upper story should extend one fire-part.
uncertainties: agnibhāgaikaṃ interpreted as one part out of three based on agni symbolism
plain_english: On the upper story, the central projection should extend by one part out of three.
